subject: OEM activation checklist for ForgeWorks tooling integration
messages:
From: Elena March <elena@forgeworks.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: partnerships@forgeworks.com
Date: 2026-09-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OEM engagement — next steps and activation checklist

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the demo last week. ForgeWorks is excited about embedding Redwood inference into our developer tooling. Before we start the SOW and marketplace listing, can you send an "activation checklist" that outlines:

- Required legal artifacts (term sheet, data processing addendum)
- Technical handoffs (api keys, sandbox access, compatibility matrix)
- Operational commitments (SLA, support tiers, onboarding PS hours)
- Privacy and telemetry controls (what data Redwood stores/retains)

We'd like to share that checklist with our platform engineering and legal teams to kick off parallel work. Also, can you indicate who will be our Redwood technical lead for the first 8 weeks?

Cheers,
Elena
Director of Partnerships
ForgeWorks

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena March <elena@forgeworks.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-14T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OEM engagement — next steps and activation checklist

Elena —

Great to hear — appreciate the clear ask. See attached initial activation-checklist.xlsx and the term sheet (redwood-oem-term-sheet-v1.pdf). High level answers inline below and a proposed cadence: 30-minute technical kickoff this week, followed by weekly 45-minute syncs for the first 8 weeks.

Quick answers:
- Legal: we will send a redlineable term sheet and our standard DPA. Procurement generally takes 2–4 weeks for partners of this size.
- Technical: we'll provision a sandbox project (read-only) and two API keys: one for testing and one for pilot. Our compatibility matrix supports ForgeWorks' node/electron stack; Karthik will confirm if any additional polyglot SDKs are needed.
- Ops: Redwood offers a Partner SLA addendum for OEM integrations: 99.9% uptime for dedicated pilot capacity, and a 4-hour P1 response during business hours. Onboarding PS estimate: 40–80 hours depending on the integration surface (embedding widgets vs deeper runtime bundling).
- Privacy: by default we do ephemeral KV caching; we can enable a no-retention mode for customer-specific telemetry and set a 30-day retention cap for diagnostics. Full details are in the checklist.

Technical lead: Karthik Iyer will be primary; Jordan will handle onboarding and billing flows.

Next steps:
1) Elena: confirm who on your side will be legal and eng.
2) Redwood: share redline-friendly term sheet and SOW draft (attaching).
3) Schedule kickoff: propose Thu 2026-09-16 10:00 AM PT.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-oem-term-sheet-v1.pdf, activation-checklist.xlsx, forgeworks-integration-sow-draft.docx

Grace —

Thanks for the materials; we've looped in our legal (Marco Silva) and platform eng (Priya Shah). Thu 09/16 10:00 AM PT works. A couple of quick clarifications after skimming the checklist:

- Can Redwood support a co-branded UI option for the widget that hides Redwood logos? If yes, what are the constraints?
- For the sandbox API key, will rate limiting mirror hosted production, or do you throttle lower for partners?
- On telemetry: we need a statement we can give our customers that Redwood does not retain PII. Is that something you can commit to in the DPA addendum?

Appreciate it — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Elena

All —

Quick technical notes ahead of the kickoff:

1) Co-branding: we support a themeable widget. Full white-label (no Redwood attribution) requires an OEM addendum and a small licensing premium; we can provide an embeddable NPM package with theming tokens.

2) Sandbox limits: partner sandboxes are provisioned with a throttled rate (approx 10% of pilot production) to prevent abuse. For integration testing we can temporarily lift limits for the first 72 hours around onboarding milestones.

3) PII & telemetry: Redwood's default hosted API never writes user-provided content to persistent storage unless explicitly enabled. We support a contractually-enforced no-retention mode and a field-level redaction API for sensitive attributes. Will include DPA language for PII non-retention.

4) API keys: we will issue two keys (test + pilot). Important: test key will be scoped to the sandbox project and will not authorize marketplace billing. Pilot key will be on a dedicated project tied to the ForgeWorks account.

I'll be the tech lead on integration; Jordan will own testing and billing.

See you Thursday.

-Karthik
Principal Product Engineer, Integrations
Redwood Inference
